sexual assault laws that punish more severely the perpetrator who causes the victim to become pregnant are worthy of cultural study because they define pregnancy subversively, as an injury.

the criminal law defines pregnancy as an injury to the woman’s body, which is a wholly subversive construction of pregnancy, but that the subversive character of the construction is mitigated by the fact that it describes a social injury.
